chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin sihna tawh kipawl gamtatnate, kisikkikna, Pasian upna, baptaiznate thuhilhna, khutngakna, misite’ thawhkikna, thukhen tawntungnate a bulpi, eite in lamkik loin, Khazih’ ngeina a kipatna thute koihin kicin’ nadingin kahto ni.
Pasian in thu hong piak leh, tua bang i bawl ding hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, khatvei khuavakna tungin, vantung hehpihna ciamin, Kha Siangtho tawh a kizom ngei, Pasian’ thu hoih ahi zongin, a nung ciangin a tung ding huna vangliatnate ahi zongin a ciap khit ciangin a tawp kikte ahih uh leh, amaute ading Pasian’ Tapa singlamteh tungah that kikin a simmawh uh ahih ciangin, a nung ciangin kisikkik ding bawl thakna a tung zo kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a tungah a kia ngitnget guahtui dawnin, a sem mite ading anteh an-gah a piangsak thei leitang in Pasian kiang pan thupha a ngah hi.
Ahi zongin lingkung leh thangling a pian’sak leh, paihkhiatna thuakin hamsiat a thuak nadingin, a tawpna-ah meikhuk khulna a thuak ding hi.
Ka itte aw, tua bang ka cih hangin note in gupna tawh kipawl na leh a hoihzaw nate tawh na kizom uh ci-in kote in ka lungkim uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nomau nasepna uh akipan nidang lai-in misiangthote na vaak uh tham loin, tu nangawnin na vaak uh ahi zongin, tua bang hihin ama min hangin na lah uh ki-itna ahi zongin Pasian in a mangngilh dingin thumanlo-pa ahi kei hi.

Note khempeuh in thadahna nei loin, upna leh thuakna hangin thuciamna a luah ding mite bangin na gamtat zawh nadingun, a tawp dongin upkhialhna nei loin, lametna tawh na dim nadingun, na hahkat nadingun ka deih uh hi.
Pasian in Abraham thuciamna a piak ciangin, amah sangin a lianzaw tawh ciam ding om lo ahih ciangin amahmah tawh,
“Nang a man takpi thupha kong pia ding hi, nang a man takin kong khangsak ding hi,” ci-in a ciam hi.
Tua mah bangin Abraham in thuakin a ngak khit ciangin a thuciamna bangin a ngah hi.
Mite in amau sang a lianzawte tawh a kiciam thei uh hi. Kinialna khempeuh kiciamna in a beisak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thuciamna a luah ding mite in Pasian’ hanciamna a kikheel zo lo a theih tel nadingun, Pasian in kiciamna tawh a kikham hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in zuauthu a zang zo lo thu nih hangin eite mai-ah hong kikoih lametna len a, a beel dinga tai eite in hansuahna khauh i ngah nading ahi hi.
Tua lametna in puan dalna sungah tumin, lungsim kipna siklum bangin eite ading a om hi.
Tua sungah Zeisu in Melkhizedek’ pawl ahi, a kip tawntung Siampi Ukpa a suah khit ciangin eite taang dingin a masa in a tum hi.
